title: Earthy Mustard Resin & Wood Square Drop Earrings
storyHtml:
A glossy mustard resin nugget atop an open square of warm natural wood — earthy, tactile and effortlessly autumnal. Lightweight enough to wear all day.

Jewelry that marks your every becoming.
detailsBullets: Gold-plated post with hand-poured mustard resin
